hypothesis: Some of five prior budget-stopped windows may reach continuous convergence when the same fixed objective receives thirty corrections; persistent kinks or guards may still prevent it
data_role: already viewed development; fixed-source budget comparison only
initial_state: Same original poses, node timestamps and incoming priors as the preceding sampling-domain reports
fixed_population: Select initial sampling-qualified sources and center normalizers once for the entire solve; no reassociation, source dropping or normalization reset at checkpoints
prior: Same original nonlinear incoming prior at every iteration; no posterior accumulation, elimination or tracker commits
unchanged: Sampling-domain residual and exact derivative, Huber weights, support>=200, SPD condition<=1e6, full proposal<=0.1m/0.15rad, eight Armijo multipliers1..1/128 and strict continuous1e-5m/1e-5rad convergence
stop: Stop immediately on proposal guard, convergence or search failure; otherwise consume the thirty-correction cap
checkpoint_order: At a requested cap, proposal guards and convergence are checked before budget termination; an exhausted next search after that cap cannot retroactively change its budget result
terminal_carry_forward: Endpoints after an earlier terminal stop explicitly retain the actual correction count and terminal state
control: Require the complete reconstructed cap10 report to equal the archived sampling-domain control, including population, weights, systems, poses, searches and stop cause
independent_validation: Previous private fixed-objective verifier changes only correction limits; independently reconstruct each checkpoint system, original-discrete fresh system, costs, corrections and event order from original observations
matrix_counts: Long trace/final, rechecked control and checkpoint matrix roles are reported separately; repeated endpoints are not independent measurements
followup_eligibility_rule: Both cases must converge all five continuous windows, improve original-discrete fresh-converged counts, have no local or fresh guards, pass all original0.03m RMS gates and have original-discrete median RMS no worse than cap10
scope: Local comparison only; no new full trajectory fitting, physical scoring, default adoption or tracker integration
